plan.archetype: Frontloaded damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and dexterity powers during sleep. Bring efficient block, sustained poison, healthy HP, and stocked potions; siphoning punishes reliance on basic attacks.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then build poison scaling and reliable defense. Fight elites with damage and potion support, remove Strikes, and balance upgrades against healing.

plan.archetype: Sustained poison with dexterity defense and efficient early damage
plan.bossPrep: Establish powers during sleep. Bring sustained poison, dexterity, upgraded replay Defend or Neutralize, healthy HP, and defensive potions to withstand siphoning.
plan.summary: Heal before the forced elite; avoid optional elites without potion support. Prioritize poison scaling and dexterity, remove Strikes, and upgrade replay Defend or Neutralize when healthy. Current boss simulations show substantial unmet damage needs.
